name: phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting protein 2

function.text: PACS2 is the approved symbol for phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting protein 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in autophagosome assembly; endoplasmic reticulum calcium ion homeostasis.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include genetic developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 66 (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: PACS2 encodes phosphofurin acidic cluster sorting protein 2. Its functions include autophagosome assembly and endoplasmic reticulum calcium ion homeostasis.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include genetic developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (autosomal dominant); developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 66 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PACS2 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
